title: At the Cafe
text:
This is the menu at Sun Cafe. It has soup, salad and pizza. The soup is hot and good. The salad is cold and fresh.

Tom wants pizza and a glass of water. Anna wants soup. They pay at the end. The cafe is open until nine.

options: Pizza and a glass of water

questions.text: What kind of place is Sun Cafe most likely to be?
Why do Tom and Anna pay at the end?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
a dish of mixed vegetables, often eaten cold

paragraph_translations: Bu Sun Cafe'nin menüsü. Çorba, salata ve pizza var. Çorba sıcak ve lezzetli. Salata soğuk ve taze.
Tom pizza ve bir bardak su istiyor. Anna çorba istiyor. Sonunda ödeme yapıyorlar. Kafe dokuza kadar açık.
